integrity: A definition-based standalone finite verifier supplements a full general proof. This work has not received independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only full regular finite rooted trees, d>=2 and h>=0, with reflexive prefix order. Earlier equivalent formulas may exist outside the indexed literature. Exhaustive computation is limited to frames of size at most seven, and the general proof is combinatorial.
title: Cone-image rigidity and exact bounded-morphism rank spectra of finite regular tree frames
